shortdesc.ph: Stops or resumes subscribing to all remote users’ audio streams.
Stops or resumes subscribing to the audio streams of all remote users.

section.p: After calling this method, the local user will stop or resume subscribing to all remote users’ audio streams, including users who join the channel later.

ul.li: Call this method after calling joinChannel.
When using spatial audio, if you need to set whether to stop subscribing to all remote users’ audio streams, Agora recommends using this method instead of the method with the same name under .
After calling this method, you need to call and to update the spatial positions of the local and remote users, otherwise the settings of this method will not take effect.

section.p: After successfully calling this method, the local user stops or resumes subscribing to the audio streams of all remote users, including all subsequent users.

ul.li: Call this method after the or method.
When using the spatial audio effect, if you need to set whether to stop subscribing to the audio streams of all remote users, Agora recommends calling this method instead of the method in .
After calling this method, you need to call and to update the spatial location of the local user and the remote user; otherwise, the settings in this method do not take effect.
